backends.description:
Your own backends, added to the shipped model server backend in
`BACKENDS`. A backend of `kind: openai` is an LLM endpoint (any OpenAI
compatible API), and turns on the agentic labeler. On an OpenAI backend with
`openaiHosted` and `files`, the labeler uses its model `gpt-6-sol-responses`
(`wireFormat: openai-responses`). Otherwise it uses the first model of the
first `kind: openai` backend, which needs `wireFormat: openai-chat` and
`limits.maxImagesPerRequest`. Either needs `generation` in its tasks. A
backend names its token's variable in `auth.tokenEnv`, set from a Secret
with `secretEnv`. See the README for LLM examples.
backends.title: backends

global.title: global

pullPolicy.title: pullPolicy

tag.title: tag

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for a private registry.
imagePullSecrets.title: imagePullSecrets

labeler.description:
The shared agentic labeling service. It runs when a backend has
`kind: openai`. It calls `gpt-6-sol-responses` on an OpenAI backend with
`openaiHosted` and `files`, otherwise the first model of the first
`kind: openai` backend.

env.description:
Labeler environment variables, by name. They win over the ones the
chart sets. The labeler fetches media only from public addresses on port
443 by default. For media in a private object store, set
`LABELER_FETCH_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, `LABELER_FETCH_ALLOWED_NETWORKS`,
`LABELER_FETCH_ALLOWED_PORTS` and, for plain http,
`LABELER_FETCH_ALLOW_HTTP: "true"`. Lists are JSON strings, such as
`'["minio.internal"]'`, not YAML lists.

LABELER_MAX_IN_FLIGHT_TESTS.description: Jobs at once. Each holds its images in memory, about 3.4 GiB at most.
LABELER_MAX_IN_FLIGHT_TESTS.title: LABELER_MAX_IN_FLIGHT_TESTS

env.title: env

tag.description: Labeler image tag. Defaults to the chart `appVersion`.
tag.title: tag

resources.description:
Not set by default. One job at once needs about 4Gi of memory.
Labeler container resources.

licenseSecrets.description:
Existing Secrets holding the FiftyOne Enterprise licenses, one per org,
under the key `license`: the ones the fiftyone-teams-app chart mounts for
CAS (its `fiftyoneLicenseSecrets`). Each call is admitted against the
license of the org it names: unexpired, it admits every call, expired, none.
A new org's license needs a restart.
licenseSecrets.title: licenseSecrets

maxBodyBytes.description: Largest request body in bytes. Images are sent inline, so this is large.
maxBodyBytes.title: maxBodyBytes

enabled.description:
Declare the model server backend this chart ships: every model the
voxel51 model server image serves (`catalog/model-server.yaml`). A chart
upgrade brings the new ones. Off leaves only `backends`.
enabled.title: enabled

name.description:
Name of the fiftyone-model-server release in this namespace: its
release name, or its `nameOverride`.
name.title: name

replicas.description:
Its `replicas`. The model servers are then
`http://<name>-<i>:8080` for i from 0, one per pod.
replicas.title: replicas

tokenSecret.description:
Existing Secret holding the model servers' bearer token under the key
`token`: the fiftyone-model-server chart's `token` (its Secret
`<name>-token` from `token.value`, or your own). Empty: the model servers
check no token.
tokenSecret.title: tokenSecret

urls.description:
The model servers, one URL per box, used instead of `name` and
`replicas` when set: for model servers in another namespace or cluster.
urls.title: urls

podSecurityContext.description:
Pod security context of both pods, added to `runAsNonRoot: true`,
`runAsUser: 1000` and `runAsGroup: 1000`. Those cannot be set to false or 0.
podSecurityContext.title: podSecurityContext

resources.description:
Not set by default, as in the main chart. The service sizes how many request
bodies it holds at once from its memory limit, and refuses to start when the
limit cannot hold one `maxBodyBytes` body: 1Gi holds two 64 MiB bodies.
To set them, uncomment and adjust, and remove the curly braces after
`limits:` and `requests:`.
Inference service container resources.
resources.title: resources

secretEnv.description:
Environment variables of the inference service from existing Secrets,
such as the LLM token a backend's `auth.tokenEnv` names.
secretEnv.title: secretEnv

securityContext.description:
Container security context of both pods, added to
`allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`.
securityContext.title: securityContext

secretName.description:
Existing Secret holding the shared token under the key `token`. Every
caller sends this token: FiftyOne Enterprise and the labeler.
secretName.title: secretName

value.description:
The shared token, used to create the Secret `<release>-token` when
`sharedToken.secretName` is empty. At least 32 characters, or the service
refuses to start. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
value.title: value

storeMode.description:
Where the catalog and per organization model settings live. `memory`
loses the settings at restart. `mongo` needs `MONGO_URI` in `secretEnv`.
storeMode.title: storeMode

tolerations.description: Tolerations of both pods, for tainted nodes for example.
tolerations.title: tolerations
